title: T-minus 7 — Owner Action Docket
body:
Notes to self — week of T-7 (personal docket, quick hitters + decision prompts)

Context: weekly release train sync on Thu 09:30 PST. This is my personal working list for the week — owners called out, quick verification items, and the go/no-go checklist I want visible before the huddle. Not a canonical runbook (see Confluence link above), this is my distilled, actionable view.

Meeting logistics:
- Weekly: Thu 09:30 PST (Zoom) — lead: Ethan Rivera (eng) joins for rollout plan review.
- Gate call window for final Go/No-Go: Mon 07:00–09:00 PST (ops on-call + SRE), Wed 16:00 PST dry-run.

Agenda (my standing items to bring up):
1) Quick health-checks (infra + infra canaries) — status + owners
2) Canary performance numbers (p95 latency, error rate, throughput) — Jordan to report
3) Model artifact & bundle verification — PR/sha and checksum verified? (Priya)
4) Rollout policy: gradual vs big-bang; fallback plan pinned? (Ethan/Maya)
5) Communication plan for customers & internal pages (support + sales)
6) Final Go/No-Go criteria readout + owners sign-off

Personal quick checklist (T-7 to T-0) — owner / desired state / notes
- Infra capacity reservation: Ethan Rivera / confirmed / PROD GPU pool reserved, burst policy on (2026-03-10)
- Canary dataset KV-cache seed: Jordan Kim / in progress / need one more eval (JIRA REL-2142)
- Model container build & signed artifact: Priya Shah / done / sha: a1b2c3d (verify in prod staging)
- E2E smoke harness run (30s requests) on staging: Maya Patel / todo / schedule Wed 16:00 dry-run
- Telemetry retention for this rollout: Ops / in_review / ensure 14-day retention for traces
- Alert thresholds reviewed: SRE / done / added 2 more P50/P95 thresholds
- Release notes draft: Maya Patel / in_progress / needs PM review (email PM by Tue)
- Feature flags & rollout percentage config: Eng / todo / default to 5% step increments
- Rollback test validated (DB migrations / config): Infra / blocked / awaiting infra PR merge (INFRA-879)
- Legal/compliance checklist for private deployments: Legal / done / no blockers

Go / No-Go criteria (personal shorthand — read aloud during gate):
- Critical infra green: canaries pass p95 < 220ms, errors < 0.5% over 1h window — if fail -> NO GO
- Staging smoke pass: all smoke tests pass within T+30m and no new top-10 errors introduced — if fail -> NO GO
- Model artifact checksum matches production manifest and PR merged — if mismatch -> NO GO
- Rollout config in control plane + rollback tested in staging — if absent or rollback fails -> NO GO
- Customer communications prepared (outage/behavior change note ready) and comms owner assigned — if not -> CAUTION (escalate)

Risk notes / mitigations I care about:
- Risk: KV-cache cold miss storm during ramp. Mitigation: pre-warm using synthetic requests in the 2h pre-rollout window (Jordan)
- Risk: sudden spike in token cost due to unexpected long contexts. Mitigation: add hard token cap at N=2048 for first 48h and monitor (Maya)
- Risk: model variant fallback incompatibility. Mitigation: ensure fallback model is warmed and tested, add auto-fallback policy with rate limiter

Open questions I want discussed in this weekly:
- Do we need a temporary rate limit for anonymous API keys during the first 24h? (Pros/cons)
- Confirm audit logging settings for Private tenants in this release (are exports enabled?)
- Should we freeze internal model tuning for 72h post-rollout?

Personal action items (this doc as my source of truth)
- Tue EOD: send release note draft to PM + legal (Maya)
- Wed 14:00: run staging smoke harness and collect traces (Maya + Jordan)
- Thu 08:45: quick pre-huddle with Ethan to align go/no-go phrasing (Maya)
- Fri 10:00: post-launch wrap (incidents, follow-ups) — block calendar now

Quick comms templates (snippets to copy):
- Customer-facing: "We are rolling an update to inference runtime on <date>. Expected behavior: no change for most customers. If you see increased latency or errors, contact support@redwood.ai with subject 'Inference issue'."
- Internal incident annotation: "Release: REL-2142 — stage: canary — observed p95: XXX ms — action: rollback triggered"

Notes to self (freeform):
- Keep the gate simple. If there are >2 NO GOs, escalate and pause.
- Save last 24h of stdout logs from staging to /tmp/release-logs (for fast triage)
- Re-check PR list Thu morning; any new infra PRs after the freeze -> hold unless emergency

Bottom line: use this doc as my rapid checklist — surface only the critical owners in the meeting and keep ops focused on canaries + rollback. If anything is unclear, flag it as "callout" during sync so we capture a single owner.
private_note: author scratchpad — not the canonical runbook
